hyperparameters.tag: 300K-example subset of n=13 (time-budget fallback per spec, after earlier full-705755-example runs at lr=3e-4 constant, lr=1e-3 constant, and lr=1e-3 cosine(30ep) all plateaued well below target -- diagnosed via a small-scale (200-example) overfit probe that a 30-epoch cosine schedule was annealing lr to ~0 right as the model was mid-phase-transition (loss still falling); dropout also changed from PyTorch's default 0.1 to 0.0, better suited to this exact-match/deterministic-function task. Using 300K subset + 80 epochs to get enough optimizer steps for the transition within the ~4h MPS time budget.
